name: Facet
text: Use a dark theme with high-contrast interactive charts. It matches Manus’s color scheme, ensuring consistency and reducing eye strain in low-light screencasts. The trade-off is glare in daylight, but we control lighting during recordings.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A dark theme with high contrast fails in mixed lighting—even controlled recordings risk glare when presenters move between shaded and bright areas. A light theme with dark accents keeps text readable in any light but risks blending into white backgrounds; the real fix is a dynamic theme that auto-adjusts contrast based on ambient light, settled by testing both under glare and daylight.
